name: 晚安免洗睡眠面膜整夜滋养款
description: 晚间涂抹免洗的膏状睡眠面膜套图，月白雾青与暮金的安静夜调

styleLock.backgroundSystem: moonstone-white #FCFBF7 for packshot and flat lay, misty celadon-grey #E7EEED for info and close shots, deep charcoal-ink #34313F for pain-point and brush macro, warm linen bedroom set for scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key with gentle contact shadows on light fields; dim warm 3200K lamp glow in the night scene; soft skimming side light for texture macros
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte linen cloth, matte cream board #F2EBDD, pale frost-celadon board #DCE7E4, deep charcoal-ink matte surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, dark ink #34313F headings on light fields only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single dusk-gold accent #B08D5F
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright tube hero angle; the packshot angle repeats only in the CTA group; macros and flat lays stay consistent in scale
noDrift: no invented efficacy claims or percentages
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet nighttime skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of moonstone-white #FCFBF7, misty celadon-grey #E7EEED, deep charcoal-ink #34313F and one dusk-gold accent #B08D5F; soft diffused studio lighting with gentle contact shadows on light fields and dim warm lamp glow in night scenes; modern geometric sans-serif in ink #34313F; consistent thin-line icon style; clean premium skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 冰蓝色软管配金色底盖的主视觉，带水珠与绿叶、品牌字标题；P2 参数区（品牌/产地/净含量/膏状质感/功效/特点/适合肤质/晚间涂后入睡次晨温水清洗的使用方法）与模特形象横幅；P3 套装合影（软管+未印字纸盒+说明折页+面膜刷）与四枚圆形卖点章、六格肌肤困扰小图（干燥/毛孔粗大/暗沉等）；P4 困扰小图续（泛红/松弛/清洁不净）与四条编号环境因素；P5 中心产品环形光晕与五枚编号卖点小气泡图、底部双管加刷横排；P6 两只玻璃罐盛蜂蜜与药材的成分示意与使用方法开头；P7 使用方法条目、手背膏体涂抹实拍、白底产品实拍图；P8 管与盒白底实拍两帧；P9 全家福带二维码与会员促销角标。品类判定：参数区品名为睡眠面膜、质感标注膏状、用法为晚间涂抹过夜后清洗，属面部护肤而非着色彩妆，与源夹名不符，改判为护肤个护/面部护理。已剥离：品牌中英文字标与系列名、模特面容、纸盒盒面美术、原文功效段落与成分故事、净含量与产地等数值、使用频次数字、二维码与会员促销角标、全部原文案；产品一律以 {product} 占位，图内文字改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n}。与近似模版差异：1) 色板全新——月石白 #FCFBF7、雾青 #E7EEED、黛墨 #34313F、暮沙金 #B08D5F 经全库检索均未在本 L1/L2 段任何套图中出现；2) 背景体系另起——黛墨暗场分屏痛点、亚麻床头夜景、暗场刷具微距，段内无同类夜调暗场体系（段内深色底均为蓝紫/墨绿科技向）；3) 机位体系不同——frontal matched split 开痛点、candid eye-level 床头夜景、连续两支暗场与奶板微距、90 度俯拍全家福、高 45 度步骤图、桌面级上仰收口，不复用段内『straight-level 首镜接 extreme-close 中段』的通用序列；4) 角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>DETAIL>TRUST>DETAIL>CTA 与段内 41 套均不相同；5) 道具体系全新——亚麻布巾、哑光陶碟、奶油色膏体挖抹板、未印字刷具与空白步骤芯片，不含段内高频的水花、气泡、冰块、珍珠、棕榈叶与云朵基座。
